findings.description: María Concepción Fuenmayor was the daughter of Juan Fuenmayor and Graciliana Fuenmayor.
supporting_sources: Venezuela, registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1577-2022 — marriage entry for Eduardo Berrueta and María Tereza Fuenmayor, 13 January 1912, Nuestra Señora de la Chiquinquirá, Maracaibo, naming her parents Juan Fuenmayor and Graciliana Fuenmayor. The bride is María Concepción Fuenmayor (GMH9-3BJ); "María Tereza" is an indexing variant of her given name: ark:/61903/1:1:QVMV-ZVBD

findings.description: María Concepción Fuenmayor married Eduardo Berrueta on 13 January 1912 at Maracaibo, Zulia, Venezuela.
supporting_sources: Venezuela, registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1577-2022 — marriage entry of 13 January 1912, Nuestra Señora de la Chiquinquirá, Maracaibo, for Eduardo Berrueta (son of Andrés Berrueta and María del Rosario Fernández) and María Tereza Fuenmayor: ark:/61903/1:1:QVMV-ZVBD
